description: Search the Orbit music catalog by artist, title, genre or a natural request. No authorization needed. Returns up to 10 tracks with their articleId, prices in EURc and a link.

genre.description: Optional genre or subgenre, for example dance, techno, house, jazz, rock.

limit.description: Optional max result count. Defaults to 5, capped at 10.

query.description: Search for artist, song, or natural request such as 'find me a popular dance track'. No login required.

sort.description: Optional result ordering. Defaults to popular, or latest when explicitly requested.

name: search_music

displayCard.description: Markdown to show to the user.

error.description: Present when the call did not succeed.

rentPrice.description: Price for 30 days of streaming, in EURc.

title: Search music
